nodes.label: A framework is a pack of the registry; the engine ships none
nodes.summary: An architecture framework is a pack of the registry, with its adapter in its own `code/`, installed like any pack and chosen through the adapter seam; the engine ships no framework adapter, and CALM, the first, moves to Cynergis/oto-registry as the `calm` pack.
